title: Signed intersection cancellation
statement: Let $S$ and $J$ be finite subsets of a set, and let $g$ be a real-valued function on its finite subsets. If $S\nsubseteq J$, then $\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}g(T\cap J)=0$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ and $J$ are finite subsets of a type with decidable equality
$g$ maps finite subsets to real numbers
replaced: For finite subsets $S,J$ of a set and a real function $g$ on finite subsets, if $S\nsubseteq J$ then $\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}g(T\cap J)=0$.
